svg.text: A square frame of 25 x 25 tube, 300 x 300 outside, mitred and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: welded, on four legs of the same tube, 70 long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld a 60 x 60 x 5 pad under each leg so the stand does not sink

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into the floor board. Overall height 100.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 300 x 300 cast grate sits loose on the frame; its top is

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stand it in the middle of the floor, under the coil. The space

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the grate is the ash pit; the air inlet opens into it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the grate sits flat and does not rock; there is 280 from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the grate top to the lowest turn of the coil.
